name: Vacuum systemd journal (Linux)
description: Removes journal entries older than a number of days and reports size before and after.

params.name: keep_days
params.label: Days to keep
params.description: Journal entries older than this are removed.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) only reports the journal size.

output: [DRY-RUN]/[DONE]/[SKIP] lines with sizes. Exit 0; NOT AVAILABLE without journalctl.
